label: rem:vorticity-lower-bound-argument
title: Biot--Savart dynamics and vorticity concentration behind the lower bound
html:
Argument for (a): Biot--Savart dynamics. Two anti-parallel vortex filaments induce velocity on each other. The Biot--Savart ODE gives d(t) \sim \sqrt{T^*-t}. For q > 1, quantum pressure arrests the approach. The Biot--Savart dynamics holds up to the quantum length scale.

Argument for (b): Vorticity concentration. Mutual induction intensifies the vorticity through the stretching mechanism. The stretching term scales as \Gamma / d^2. This gives exponential amplification of vorticity between stretching events. The sharper bound \omega_{\max} \gtrsim c/(T^* - t) follows from constructive addition at the symmetry plane.
